description: Are these postings still on the board? Up to 50 ids a call with no key, 200 with one: re-verify a saved shortlist before acting on it. Returns open:{id:boolean} and the closed ids, read from the board's index (a closed posting is one the employer's feed stopped listing), not the employer's site at this instant: read `basis` before telling a person a posting is open.

ids.description: Job ids from search_jobs; ids past the cap are named in notChecked.

name: check_jobs_open
title: Check which jobs are still open
